example: Patent Markush structure: 2-aryl indole macrocycle with variable rings A and C

source.rights: The reference figure is not relicensed under the software license.

claim_text.note: Illustrative claim wording written for this example; the definitions are not taken from the source patent.

workflow.answering_model: a language model agent given only the Skill folder, the image and the claim text

verification.comparison: labelled atom graph and variable-attachment groups compared after canonicalisation

limitations: The short N-NH dash inside ring A is not drawn; the bond is present in the structure.
The (RA)n and (RC)p lines end at their ring circles instead of crossing into them, and the open arc of ring A is drawn as a closed circle.
The detection and drafting code was developed on this figure, so this case does not measure accuracy on unseen figures.
Ring A, ring C and Y are defined only by class names, so they are kept as text and not enumerated.
The [*:1]/[*:2] orientation of the L2 value C(CH3)2CH2 follows the bond order in the spec and was not checked against a claim.
